limitations: Actual real-source GPU case is sourceRock4 mudstone -> fractured-bedrock recipe; basalt/carbonate mapping checked CPU, not separately rendered here
Close80triangle forms remain visibly faceted, not scanned rocks or artistic final acceptance
All-camera near test fully resolves the rock: no GPU alpha-fade threshold/shadow sweep or normal-direction texture oracle
Grass/tree asset flags omitted identically to isolate clasts; other legacy glyphs are outside this fix
Six process durations include initialization and five captures, not FPS or navigation latency
